==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.) A black metal mouth with needle teeth is trying to eat a balloon planet. (As I was going to sleep, I was thinking about the idea of a ""Balloon Animal Man"". I thought the name was silly, but that character could theoretically be extremely powerful. I thought about how strong someone could be if they could animate their balloon constructs, and their constructs were just as powerful as the real thing. I think that was the inspiration for the balloon planet. It was almost as if my subconscious was challenging the idea of a ""Balloon Animal Man"" being so powerful, by presenting its greatest nemesis.) Leon in his mech form holds the mouth open to prevent it from biting down. Overdrive sees a hinge inside of the mouth and destroys it, eliminating the threat.
